Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly redefined the criteria for determining which film came out earlier. In Step 3, after initially gathering data showing Niyoti had an earlier release in India (June 10, 2016) compared to Angali Pangali's June 17, 2016, the Planner arbitrarily decided to ignore the earlier regional release date of Niyoti and instead prioritize the "primary country" release date from IMDb (August 12, 2016 for Niyoti in Bangladesh). This decision contradicted the initial finding and the standard interpretation of "came out earlier" (which usually refers to the first public release anywhere). By switching the metric mid-analysis without justification, the Planner caused the final conclusion to be reversed from the evidence found in the first search.
